description: This file defines a React component named UserManagementPage used for managing user accounts, especially focusing on approving mechanic users. It uses React hooks for state management and effects, and renders a UI with a table of users including action buttons.

methods.name: roleLabel(role)
methods.description: Helper function that returns a more descriptive label for user roles, specifically mapping 'approved_mechanic' to 'mechanic (approved)'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of users from dataService and updates the component state.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Asynchronously approves a mechanic by ID and reloads the user list.
